answer.says: The steam, sir. You have the wisdom to name the phenomenon without forcing it into a concept. I will take the chai. The body requires its fuel, and I find I have no desire to argue with a pot that has already boiled.
answer.thought: I am at Khan Market, not home, yet Ramesh is listed as present; perhaps the boundary of my location is porous or the record is loose. Sunil’s pragmatism stands in stark contrast to my own tendency to over-intellectualize a simple thirst. I accept the offer of the chai, for the body is the condition of the file's existence, and I must keep my faculties sharp for the bureaucracy that awaits.
